gold_features1:
Features of Travian Plus:

The following are optional additions to the Plus account
  • Increase in Lumber production by 25%
  • Increase in Clay production by 25%
  • Increase in Iron production by 25%
  • Increase in Crop production by 25%
  • Attack value increased by 10%
  • Defence value increased by 10%
  • Buildings completed immediately
  • NPC merchant
gold_features2:
Features of Travian Plus:

Lumber production +25%

With this, the production of lumber can be increased by 25%. The bonus counts for the whole account and the increase applies to the account's summed up production, not the tiles in the villages. NOT included in the Gold club!

Clay production +25%

With this, the production of clay can be increased by 25%. The bonus counts for the whole account and the increase applies to the account's summed up production, not the tiles in the villages. NOT included in the Gold club!

Iron production +25%

With this, the production of iron can be increased by 25%. The bonus counts for the whole account and the increase applies to the account's summed up production, not the tiles in the villages. NOT included in the Gold club!

Crop production +25%

With this, the production of crop can be increased by 25%. The bonus counts for the whole account and the increase applies to the account's summed up production, not the tiles in the villages. NOT included in the Gold club!

Buildings & researches completed immediately

In the current village, all construction orders and research in the academy and smithy will be completed immediately. The residence and palace are excluded from this function.

NPC merchant

The NPC merchant trades any amount of resources for resources of your choice in one village.

plus_account_title: Features of Travian Plus
warteschleife_text: The waiting loop enables you to give your builders another order to raise or extend a second building. After completing their first task they will begin working on the next construction order in the loop.
vorberechnung_text: If you do not have enough resources to raise or extend a building, you are told the exact time and date when you will have enough resources.
gr_karte_text: You can enlarge the map to get a better overview. Instead of 7x9 fields, you can have a map of 11x19 fields. Other alliances which are allied or have a non-aggression pact (NAP) with you are shown in special colours.
archiv_title: Archive function for reports and messages
archiv_text: Important reports and messages can be archived and thereby be looked up faster. Additionally, you can choose several messages or reports and archive or delete them at once.
sort_title: Sorting function for reports and messages
sort_text: By clicking the table heading "Sent", you can reverse the sorting of reports and messages. If you get many messages a day and need to look up older ones, you are able to do so very fast with this function. It can also be used in the archives.
sort_mark_text:
To use the marketplace more efficiently, you can filter the offers for certain resources only. Additionally, you can use a ratio filter to only see 1:1 offers.

This feature is available to everyone and NOT part of the plus account any more.
autovv_text: By using the auto-completion you can easily "write" a whole village name by entering just a few letters/figures. Depending on your preferences, you can use this function in any combination for your own villages, villages of alliance members or villages in your surroundings.
bfilter_text: Thanks to the report filter, unwanted reports concerning marketplace transactions are a problem of the past. Depending on your personal preferences, you can easily switch off reports concerning trades from/to other villages or between your own villages.
ext_ksim_text:
You can add the level of your and your enemy's troops' weapon and armor which have been increased by the Smithy. Additionally, you can also add the levels of the palace/residence, wall and the population of the affected accounts.

This is no longer a plus feature, but can be used by every player for free.
dlinks_text: Thanks to these links, you can reach every page you want with just one click. Just create a link to every destination you want and you can directly reach your alliance's overview, your barracks or the tempting 1:1 biddings at the marketplace.
plus_stats_text: The following graphs show a time progression of economy, population, and the military strength of your army.
zuebersicht_text: Anyone who reigns over several villages might easily miss something important going on within his realm: where are those troops I've trained, are all my workers working hard or are some of them being lazy, am I losing resources because one of my warehouses isn't big enough? Just take a look at your central village overview and you can check out all your villages at once. If you own more than one village, you can reach the central village overview by clicking "Villages" directly above the list of your villages.
notizblock_text: A paper and pencil aren't always at hand. In order to make sure you don't forget important things, or if you simply want to make a few notes, you can use your ingame notebook.
plus_vorteile_title: Features of Travian <font color="#71D000">G</font><font color="#FF6F0F">o</font><font color="#71D000">l</font><font color="#FF6F0F">d</font>

gold_transfer_text:
Hello [NAME],

We have sent out an email to the address this account is registered with.
The email contains a link which will allow you to transfer the remaining [INT] Gold from your current account to another account.

When clicking on the link in the email, you will be directed to a page on which you have to enter the email address the link was sent to. As soon as that was done, you can select a server and enter the name of the account you would like your gold to be transferred to.

In case you would like to keep your gold until the restart of the same server, please make sure to keep this email. Your gold balance can then be transferred by clicking on the transfer link and entering the your new account data once the new server has started.

Regards,

Plus Support

ig_goldclub_nightwatch: The night watch contains of troops from your tribe. The bigger your village, the more troops will be send. The night watch will protect your village for [INT] nights, exept they get destroyed or are send away. The troops will deliver crop for 10 hours worth of their supply. If your Granary is not large enough or you send the crop for other things, the night watch may starve. The night watch needs 2 hours to arrive. If you call the night watch during the night, they still need 2 hours to arrive and will only be send if the night lasts for at least 2 hours. Otherwise the night watch will arrive during the next night. The night watch will leave your village after 10 hours and will return during the next night.
